problems.text: Bifrost logs in to Postgres with a static Terraform-generated password that never expires, so a leaked copy works until someone changes it by hand
No Vault database secrets engine for Postgres exists, so no job can get a short-lived Postgres user

goals.text: Bifrost's Postgres credential dies with its lease, and a revoked lease's user can no longer connect
Converting the next Postgres consumer is one entry in a list plus its jobspec change

outcomes.change: The `developer` policy grants the `postgres` mount and its config and roles paths
outcomes.checked_by: an infrastructure apply, then `vault token capabilities sys/mounts/postgres` on a `localstack login` session reads create, read, update, delete

outcomes.change: A `postgres` database engine mints users as `vault-dbengine-admin`, one role per entry in `local.postgres_dynamic_consumers`
outcomes.checked_by: `vault read postgres/config/postgres` shows username `vault-dbengine-admin`; `terraform state pull` holds zero copies of the admin password; `vault read postgres/creds/bifrost` mints a user whose `current_user` is `bifrost`

outcomes.change: Each converted job gets its own Vault policy and JWT role reading only its `postgres/creds/<job>` path
outcomes.checked_by: `vault read auth/jwt-nomad/role/postgres-bifrost` shows `bound_claims` on `nomad_job_id = bifrost` and both `nomad-workloads` and the creds-read policy

outcomes.change: Bifrost reads a minted Postgres user and its static password is gone
outcomes.checked_by: on the live cluster, Bifrost's alloc is healthy and its virtual keys list; `vault lease revoke` on its lease leaves 0 rows in `pg_roles` for the user and a fresh login refused; the old `bifrost` password is refused; `vault kv get secret/default/bifrost/db` is not found; `select count(*) from pg_class c join pg_roles r on r.oid = c.relowner where r.rolname like 'v-%'` in the bifrost database is 0

outcomes.change: The knowledge bundle and docs say the engine is built and where it lives
outcomes.checked_by: `kmctl check` passes and `deployment-layers.md` names the applications-root engine as a known exception in its owns table and Depicts section
